items.title: Eq25: affinity of the actual single-block mixtures

source.anchor: Appendix B.2.3 proof of Lemma3.3, A2.SS2.SSS3.p2.1-p2.4, Ex68 (affinity), Ex69 (TV/Cauchy-Schwarz), Eq25; definitions S2.p2.1, S3.E4/S3.SS1.p3.1, A2.SS2.p2.1; Proposition B.7 Eq19 atomic parent.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. Faithful restatement of the single-block TV–affinity comparison and Eq25, with actual density representatives made explicit.
source.scope: Actual single block only, every n≥3 and κ≥4. No full block-product law or main lower-bound theorem.

items.statement:
The actual sign-conditioned Gaussian mixtures have genuinely integrable affinity and satisfy the TV comparison and Eq25. a\le\sqrt{1-	frac14e^{-10n/\sqrt\kappa}}\le\exp\!\left(-	frac18e^{-10n/\sqrt\kappa}ight). Exactly \(n\in\mathbb N,\ n\ge3\) and \(\kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge4\), including endpoints and odd dimensions. \(\mu\) is normalized Haar on full \(O(n)\); \(
u_b=2\mu|_{\{\det O=b\}}\), \(A_O= rac{\kappa+1}{2}I- rac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^	op)\), and \(P_b=
u_b\mathrm{bind}[O\mapsto\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})]\). The source densities are determined Lebesgue-a.e. The chosen \(q_b\) are the actual conditioned-Haar averages of the full Gaussian precision density. Their nonnegativity, measurability, genuine L1, mass one and actual-law identities are obtained internally from the canonical producer. \(\delta\) is normalized event TV, not the unnormalized variation norm. Affinity L1/range, the TV comparison and B.7 are internal dependencies, never caller hypotheses. p_O(x)= rac{\sqrt{\det A_O}}{(2\pi)^{n/2}}e^{-x^	op A_Ox/2},\quad q_b(x)=\int p_O(x)\,d
u_b(O),\quad a=\int\sqrt{q_+q_-}\,dx,\quad\delta=\sup_{B\ \mathrm{meas.}}|P_+(B)-P_-(B)|.
assumptions: Exactly \(n\in\mathbb N,\ n\ge3\) and \(\kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge4\), including endpoints and odd dimensions.
\(\mu\) is normalized Haar on full \(O(n)\); \(\nu_b=2\mu|_{\{\det O=b\}}\), \(A_O=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}I-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^\top)\), and \(P_b=\nu_b\mathrm{bind}[O\mapsto\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})]\).

The source densities are determined Lebesgue-a.e. The chosen \(q_b\) are the actual conditioned-Haar averages of the full Gaussian precision density. Their nonnegativity, measurability, genuine L1, mass one and actual-law identities are obtained internally from the canonical producer.
\(\delta\) is normalized event TV, not the unnormalized variation norm. Affinity L1/range, the TV comparison and B.7 are internal dependencies, never caller hypotheses.

obligations.label: Actual Gaussian affinity L1/range, normalized TV upper comparison and both exact Eq25 inequalities.

bindings.boundary: Only actual single-block TV-affinity comparison and Eq25, with genuine affinity L1/range. Existing density/basic-range/B7/Eq24 math is reused without new credit. The focused power consumer is scalar only: no actual independent-block product law, Eq6 coordinate/residual adapter, Tonelli tensorization, amplified TV, transcript/oracle/exact-matvec/query-cap/TV-precision/expected-cost adapters, fixed-spectrum hidden eigenbasis or either main lower bound. No overall completion or purification claim.
